rationale: The obligation asks whether the Part I Outfall 001 limits table establishes any enforceable numeric discharge limit (30-day average or daily maximum) for dissolved copper. REJECT denies that such a numeric limit is established. The packet shows the table explicitly separates DISCHARGE LIMITATIONS (including mg/l 30-Day Avg and Daily Max columns) from MONITORING REQUIREMENTS. For Dissolved Copper, both mg/l limitation columns contain Report rather than numeric values, and both lbs/day limitation columns are N/A. Contrast rows in the same table show that when enforceable numeric mg/l limits apply, the table states numeric values (Total Copper: 0.011 in both mg/l columns; Total Suspended Solids: 50 in the Daily Max mg/l column). The Dissolved Copper row therefore establishes monitoring and reporting frequency (1/Week, Grab) but does not state any numeric discharge limit against which measurements may be compared for compliance. This is grounded directly in the packet; no other passage in the packet supplies a numeric limit for dissolved copper.
